name: Navigation
use: Use for lists of places or actions
notUse: Not for animal records — use animal

name: Animal
use: Use for one animal or litter

name: Door + act
use: Use for opening details beside one immediate act
notUse: Not for a record without an act — use record

name: Scope
use: Use for choosing a work unit
notUse: Not for bulk selection — use select + door

name: Summary count
use: Use for overview counts that open a list above zero
notUse: Not for task progress cards — use the Home task card pattern

name: Done / record
use: Use for wrapped evidence and Edit
notUse: Not for event timelines — use Log

name: Tick in place
use: Use for an item ticked in place before saving (piglet day list)
notUse: Not for bulk selection — use select + door; saved items — use record

name: Select + door
use: Use when a list selects for a bulk act (Inspection pens and pigs); with a door it also opens the item, without one the whole row selects
notUse: Not for open + one-tap act — use door-act
